# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite backend preview and Vulkan packaging** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus a new Vulkan Silk.NET package. Alongside the Graphite preview, this release ships backend-neutral async pixel reads, several native use-after-free and leak fixes, more managed-side performance ports, and Skia m151/m152 servicing syncs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia bumped to milestone 152** — Updates the bundled Skia engine to m152, with several m151/m152 servicing syncs and upstream stability fixes merged along the way. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend previewed** — Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, giving early access to Skia's next-generation GPU backend. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Vulkan Silk.NET package and backend-neutral async reads** — Adds a SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package (restoring production of the Vulkan Silk.NET package) and a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API on SKImage and SKSurface. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841), [#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Improved NuGet READMEs and Apple symbol packages** — Improves NuGet package READMEs and generates Apple native symbol packages during packing. ([#4714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4714), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free and leak fixes** — Fixes native use-after-free bugs in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* by rooting the underlying native source, fixes a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on the SKImage.Create raster failure path, and fixes an undisposed SKStreamAsset leak in the HarfBuzz blob conversion path. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))
- **Runtime effect uniform buffer and Font.Shape fixes** — Disposes the previous uniform buffer in SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.Reset() to avoid leaking it, and avoids a defensive Feature[] copy in Font.Shape. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **More managed-side performance ports** — Removes char boxing in SKFourByteTag/Tag ToString, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText's null-terminated path, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, and caches a HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check. ([#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))
- **Deterministic binding generation** — Makes binding generation deterministic across platforms, and requires deterministic Android symbol identity for reproducible builds. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843))

## Platform

- **New containerized test legs and Nano Server font support** — Adds containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and uses FreeType for font support on Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515), [#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Windows native build environment fixes** — Stops pinning a default Windows SDK version and initializes the MSVC environment once per native build. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))
- **Solutions modernized to .slnx** — Converts all .sln solution files to the newer .slnx format. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Bumps the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.200 and avoids a defensive Feature[] copy in Font.Shape.
